scripts.bootstrap:full: bun run setup:app && bun run setup:catalog
scripts.test: bun run test:web && bun run test:api
scripts.ci:static: bun scripts/ci/prepare-env.ts && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run fmt:check && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run lint && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run check:boundaries && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run typecheck:app && bun scripts/ci/drizzle-drift.ts
scripts.ci:test:web: bun scripts/ci/prepare-env.ts && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run test:web:integration
scripts.ci:test:api: bun scripts/ci/prepare-env.ts && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run test:api:integration
scripts.ci:build: bun scripts/ci/prepare-env.ts && SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true bun run build
scripts.ci:docker:build: docker build --build-arg BUN_VERSION=1.3.14 -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t kyomi-api:ci . && docker build --build-arg BUN_VERSION=1.3.14 -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t kyomi-web:ci .
scripts.docker:up: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env.example -f docker/.env -- docker compose --project-directory docker up -d
scripts.docker:down: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env.example -f docker/.env -- docker compose --project-directory docker down
scripts.docker:restart: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env.example -f docker/.env -- docker compose --project-directory docker restart
scripts.docker:logs: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env.example -f docker/.env -- docker compose --project-directory docker logs -f
scripts.docker:ps: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env.example -f docker/.env -- docker compose --project-directory docker ps
scripts.docker:pull: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env.example -f docker/.env -- docker compose --project-directory docker pull
scripts.docker:build: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env.example -f docker/.env -- docker compose --project-directory docker build
scripts.setup:app: bun run docker:up && bun run db:migrate
scripts.catalog:sync: bun run catalog:export && bun run catalog:import && bun run catalog:smoke
scripts.categories:backfill: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env -f apps/api/.env -- bun scripts/categories/backfill.ts
scripts.categories:report: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env -f apps/api/.env -- bun scripts/categories/report.ts
scripts.categories:audit: bunx --no-install dotenvx run -f docker/.env -f apps/api/.env -- bun scripts/categories/audit.ts
